preamble: Paul intends to go on a sponsored trek in 26 and hopes to raise £3,500 for the National Deaf Children's Society.

clue.text: Guy injecting drug left kid

indicators.note: injecting means the drug and left go into the middle of the guy

parts.note: a dude is a guy, a bloke
E is ecstasy, the drug

explanation.surface: A man gives a child drugs and abandons it.
explanation.definitionFit: To kid someone is to fool or mislead them, a straight verb synonym.

clue.text: Is fluff under bedstead ultimately causing fire?

indicators.note: under in a down clue means after, lower in the column
ultimately picks the last letter of bedstead

parts.note: to fluff a shot is to miss it

explanation.surface: Is dust under the bed a fire risk?
explanation.definitionFit: To fire an employee is to dismiss them from a job.

clue.text: In which capital has appeared, for 26

definitions.text: In which capital has appeared, for 26

indicators.note: In signals letters found inside capital has appeared

explanation.surface: A question of which city has turned up as a stand-in for a country.
explanation.walkthrough: The hidden word is the capital of Tibet, the answer to 26, so the clue defines itself.
explanation.definitionFit: This city is the capital of Tibet, the answer to 26.

clue.text: A country like Germany upset leader of 26

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the run of pieces is turned upside down

parts.note: Mali is an African country
a la means in the manner of, like
D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: A nation resembling Germany upsets a spiritual leader.
explanation.walkthrough: A MALI ALA D reads upwards as DALAI LAMA.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dalai Lama is the spiritual head of Tibetan Buddhism.

clue.text: Bird sees pig fed salmon

indicators.note: fed means the salmon is put inside the pig, as food goes in

parts.note: a sow is a female pig
a parr is a young salmon

explanation.surface: Someone watches a pig being given fish to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: The common small brown garden songbird is an example of a bird.

clue.text: Effervescent powder hardened around mint, perhaps

indicators.note: around means the word for hardened surrounds the plant

parts.note: set means hardened, as of jelly
mint is an example of a herb

explanation.surface: Fizzy sweets are left to harden round a mint.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherbet is a fizzy sweet powder, often eaten by children in Britain.

clue.text: Own passage of mine includes introduction to manuscript

indicators.note: includes means the mine passage holds the letter

parts.note: an adit is a horizontal entry tunnel into a mine

indicators.note: introduction to picks the first letter of manuscript

explanation.surface: A mine shaft is described with an opening section of manuscript.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up is to confess, so own as a verb means acknowledge.

clue.text: Plateau in 26 doth offer "low", or otherwise?

indicators.note: otherwise means the letters are arranged in another way

explanation.surface: A Shakespearean query whether a high plateau should offer something low.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tibetan plateau is often nicknamed this for its great height.

clue.text: Fanciful behaviour brings one paper into question

indicators.note: into means the one and paper go inside the question word

parts.note: why is a question
I is the Roman numeral one
MS, manuscript, is a paper

explanation.surface: Someone's odd conduct puts a newspaper under scrutiny.
explanation.definitionFit: Whimsy is playful or fanciful behaviour, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Good times, with political extremist occupying, reversed for Chinese 26's autonomous region

indicators.note: reversed means the whole assembly is read backwards
occupying means the extremist sits between good and times

parts.note: X is the multiplication sign, times
a Nazi is a far-right extremist

explanation.surface: Good times are reversed when an extremist occupies a region.
explanation.walkthrough: G NAZI X read backwards gives the Chinese name for Tibet.
explanation.definitionFit: Xizang is the Chinese name for the Tibet Autonomous Region, the answer to 26.

clue.text: Piddling river from millstream formed

indicators.note: formed means the letters of millstream, minus river, are shaped into something new

explanation.surface: A trivial little river takes shape out of a mill stream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' signals that the river's R comes out of MILLSTREAM; 'formed' rearranges what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean petty or unimportant, minor-league, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: I wander around as antipodean

indicators.note: around means I and the word for wander are together turned back to front

parts.note: to roam is to wander

explanation.surface: Someone describes their travels in Australia or New Zealand.
explanation.definitionFit: The indigenous people of New Zealand live in the antipodes, so one is an antipodean.

clue.text: National intelligence rejected by Republican military

parts.note: the IRA was the Irish Republican Army

indicators.note: rejected means the abbreviation for intelligence is sent back, reading backwards

parts.note: IQ is a measure of intelligence

explanation.surface: A country's spy service is spurned by an army.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Republican military' is one piece, the Irish army, not R plus a separate word for military.
explanation.definitionFit: A national is a citizen of a country, here a citizen of Iraq.

clue.text: A very rare bird, of course

definitions.text: A very rare bird, of course

parts.words: A very rare bird, of course
parts.note: on a golf course birdie and eagle are under-par scores; the rarest of these bird names is three under par on one hole, and it is also a seabird

explanation.surface: An ornithologist spots a rarity, naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: Golfers name a score of three under par after a large seabird, rarer than an eagle.

clue.text: Woman given report, the whole thing

parts.note: she is a woman
a report is a loud noise, as of a gun

explanation.surface: A woman is handed a full account of everything.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'the whole shebang' means everything, so it stands for the entire affair.

clue.text: Valued eastern horses about one million

indicators.note: about means the horses surround one and million

parts.note: a stable is a set of racehorses
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Eastern horses are worth about a million.
explanation.definitionFit: Estimable means worthy of esteem, highly valued.

clue.text: Garment hard to remove from top of leg the way it's twisted

indicators.note: to remove from means the letter for hard is taken out of the top of the leg

parts.note: the thigh is the top part of the leg
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

indicators.note: twisted means the abbreviation for the way is turned around

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: Instructions for peeling off a twisted stocking.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing H from THIGH gives TIGH; ST turned by 'twisted' gives TS.
explanation.definitionFit: These close-fitting legwear items are a kind of garment.

clue.text: Sort of fever gradually spreading May 3rd/June 3rd

indicators.note: spreading means the letters of gradually, once altered, are spread around
the slash between the two dates reads as one letter giving way to the other, a swap
3rd picks the third letter of May
3rd picks the third letter of June

explanation.surface: A fever spreads slowly between early May and early June.
explanation.walkthrough: The slash swaps May's third letter Y for June's third letter N in GRADUALLY before the shuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: Glandular fever is the British name for mononucleosis, a sort of fever.

clue.text: Abandon the thread

definitions.meaning: to leave someone stuck and helpless
a single filament or length of thread

explanation.definitionFit: A strand is a thread, and to strand someone is to abandon them.

clue.text: Boring clip showing area where ships repaired

parts.note: dry means dull, boring
to dock a tail is to clip it

explanation.surface: A dull video clip of a shipyard.
explanation.definitionFit: A dry dock is a basin that is pumped empty so ships can be repaired.

clue.text: Swing and catch with comfort, say

parts.note: to trap is to catch

indicators.note: say signals that the word for comfort is heard, not spelt

parts.note: ease is comfort

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys a playground swing in comfort.
explanation.definitionFit: A trapeze is a swing hung high for acrobats.

clue.text: "Tuft" becoming "uft" when written up?

indicators.note: when written up means the letters run upwards in this down entry, so they read backwards

parts.note: the change from the first quoted word to the second is put into words, 'L-E-S-S A T', and those words are read as plain letters

explanation.surface: A pedant asks how a word loses its first letter in print.
explanation.walkthrough: LESS A T written upwards gives the answer, which is itself a tuft.
explanation.definitionFit: A tassel is a tuft of loose threads, matching the clue's opening word.

clue.text: Most inclined to avoid peak, this one on border of 26

indicators.note: to avoid peak means the top letter is dropped

parts.note: severest means steepest, the most inclined slope

explanation.surface: A trekker inclined to shun summits names one on Tibet's border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this one' points back to 'peak': the definition is a peak on Tibet's border, as the clue word 'peak' also beheads SEVEREST.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's highest mountain sits on the border between Nepal and Tibet.

clue.text: Don't gossip in prison?

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an order to be quiet, and also means confined or imprisoned.

clue.text: Man sadly's taken about a year in 26

parts.note: him stands for a man

indicators.note: taken about means the word for sadly is wrapped around a and year

parts.note: alas means sadly; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: A sad man has been away for about a year.
explanation.definitionFit: This mountain range lies partly in Tibet, the answer to 26.

clue.text: A gamble when drunk, losing head

indicators.note: losing head means the first letter is cut

parts.note: blotto means very drunk

explanation.surface: A drunk takes a gamble and loses his head.
explanation.definitionFit: Lotto is a lottery game, a form of gamble.

clue.text: Look for water, finding measure about a quarter

indicators.note: about means the measure goes round the quarter

parts.note: a dose is a measured amount of medicine
W, west, is one of the four compass quarters

explanation.surface: A water diviner measures out about a quarter.
explanation.definitionFit: To dowse is to search for underground water with a rod.

clue.text: See 6
Where my journey will be ending in enlightenment, I'm sure!

indicators.note: ending in picks the last letter of enlightenment

parts.note: 'I bet' says I am sure

explanation.surface: The setter, a trekker, is confident the trip will bring enlightenment.
explanation.walkthrough: The preamble says the setter's sponsored trek is in 26, so the definition points to the place.
explanation.definitionFit: The setter's sponsored trek, says the preamble, takes place in this Himalayan region.

clue.text: Description of round character on the brink, eating endless fat?

definitions.text: Description of round character on the brink, eating endless fat?

parts.note: the letter O is round

indicators.note: eating means the edge swallows the trimmed fat

parts.note: on the verge means on the brink

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the word for fat is cut

parts.note: lard is fat

explanation.surface: A portly person, about to binge on fat, is described.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue is also the definition: a round character eating fat would be too big.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotund figure eating fat could be described as too big, excessively sized.

clue.text: Page document — no way acceptable to prepare in advance

indicators.note: no means the way is taken out of the document

parts.note: a record is a document
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
OK means acceptable

explanation.surface: A page of paperwork that offers no acceptable way forward.
explanation.definitionFit: To cook food beforehand is to prepare it in advance, a verb phrase match.

clue.text: Tick off direct broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means the letters of direct are scattered

explanation.surface: A broadcast is told to cut off a direct transmission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tick off' looks like the definition; 'Tick' alone is it, and 'off' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: Buying on tick is buying on credit, informal British usage.
